Hannah Park: Launching preview: 'supply-chain-attest' for Private/VPC installs. Lightweight attestation flow to prove which build/artifact and image were deployed to a tenant during a given window. :package:
Hannah Park: Why: customers in regulated industries want end-to-end proof that deployed binaries match signed CI artifacts (no unexpected substitutions). This covers agent binaries, model-serving containers, and infra-init images.
Omar Aziz: How it works: on deploy we capture artifact metadata (build id, image digest, SBOM hash), sign a per-deployment attestation with the tenant signing key, and store an append-only record exportable as a signed bundle.
Hannah Park: Example CLI to fetch attestations:
```
redwoodctl private attest fetch --tenant t-707 --deploy-id d-20260407 > attest.json
jq .attestation.signature attest.json
```
Compliance: Note: if Redwood manages signing keys customers must accept the Supply-Chain Attestation Addendum. BYOK/HSM supported; air-gapped flow available.
